scope: Shared aquatic spawning, authoritative vanilla spawn API requests, original carried placement, and native spawning observations

reproductions.aquatic: All three original aquatic predicates admitted water, then native Mob obstruction rejected liquid before finalization.
reproductions.carrying: All four actual carried actors used native default passenger offsets; Mouse differed by about 0.53 blocks.

shared_fixes: WaterCreatureEntity hosts use native WaterAnimal-style final obstruction checks; terrestrial hosts retain Mob checks.
ModLoader vanilla-class AddSpawn replaces existing weights and RemoveSpawn retains final removal requests, scoped to category and biomes.
Native-player passenger attachment evaluates original carried-offset getter inside the callback transaction, retaining side effects.
SpawnGroup.getCreatureClass returns the original Monster interface, AnimalEntity and WaterCreatureEntity roots.

actual_original_regressions.aquatic_path: Native weighted selection, original predicate, native obstruction, finalization and loaded-world insertion.
carry_checks: Original passenger Y offset and carrier X/Z

natural_spawning.terrain: Fresh normal terrain, no block/light/time/selection/predicate overrides.
natural_spawning.method: Real tracked native ServerPlayer and ordinary ServerChunkCache ticks. At world tick 600, counted nonpersistent CREATURE mobs are discarded once in each disposable stage; original weights/caps remain unchanged. This isolates replenishment when a native budget exists.

earlier_morecreeps_window.result: No original insertion; original position checks ran but none reached finalization. Retained as a failed observation.
earlier_morecreeps_window.original_predicate_evidence: Hotdog requires visible sky, light >8 and a 1/5 random check; DigBug uses 1/25, while InvisibleMan, Lolliman and RocketGiraffe use 1/15 with sky/light requirements.

spawn_scarcity_findings.unmodified_initial_observation: Terrain-generated native CREATURE counts exceeded the native cap, preventing subsequent land position checks.
spawn_scarcity_findings.saved_entity_provenance: Presence in entity-region NBT does not establish natural spawn provenance.
spawn_scarcity_findings.original_morecreeps_policy: All 36 configured spawn entries use CREATURE, including monster-derived classes; categories were preserved.
spawn_scarcity_findings.remaining_counting_difference: Beta counts entities by SpawnGroup class/interface; modern native spawning counts registration categories. 29/36 MoreCreeps natural-spawn species count toward native CREATURE but do not inherit Beta AnimalEntity. No native census, cap or scheduler retuning was applied.

generic_mod_identity_guard: passed:253 production/loader files; broader guard retains 21 baseline mentions in 7 files, none added.
build_fixture_policy: Default tests remain portable. actualModTest is opt-in; runtime fixtures require entitySelfTest, and the long observation requires naturalSpawnTickSelfTest explicitly.
limitations: Controlled budget release proves replenishment, not visibility or abundance in an untouched player world.
Native spawning still differs from the complete Beta scheduler and class-based cap accounting.
No live client GPU play test; original rendering/packet CPU regressions are included in isolated suites.
Native tests use NeoForge 21.1.258; Prism uses 21.1.265 on Minecraft 1.21.1.
